zone_name: Zone 10: Graduation Stage (Dean Thudd Boss Box)

plain_mechanics.text: 60-ft rope, holds up to 3,000 lb. Magic action: command the free end to move toward a destination within 60 ft (10 ft now, 10 ft at the start of each of your turns), or to fasten, unfasten, knot, unknot or coil. Knotted: shortens to 50 ft, Advantage on climb checks. AC 20, HP 20, immune to Poison and Psychic, regains 1 HP per 5 min.

cards.spoken_line: Dean Thudd's Valedictorian Cord, Rope of Climbing. Magic action: sixty foot rope moves, knots and fastens itself.
cards.snark_line: He earned it and you took it, which is the same thing.
cards.reward: Dean Thudd's Valedictorian Cord, Rope of Climbing. Magic action: sixty foot rope moves, knots and fastens itself.

ledger.text: item +1 Silver box: Dean Thudd's Valedictorian Cord (Gold) (Rope of Climbing)

cards.box_name: Pushed the Dean Into the Orchestra Pit and Called It Extra Credit Box
cards.deed: Pushed Dean Thudd into the orchestra pit
cards.notes: Floor doc §6.7 trophy suggestion (Cord of Upward Mobility). Floor doc suggested Potion of Climbing; Uncommon Rope of Climbing keeps Silver value. Unique false: each boss-fighting crawler gets a Boss Box. DMG/SRD 2024 text per mirror 2026-10-04.

cards.reskin_name: Podium Leg, Bolted Once, Now Stuck Forever

plain_mechanics.text: Utilize action: press the button; the rod becomes fixed in place and holds up to 8,000 lb. Utilize again to release. Moving a fixed rod up to 10 ft needs a DC 30 Strength (Athletics) check. 2 lb.

cards.spoken_line: Podium Leg, Immovable Rod. Utilize to fix it in place; holds eight thousand pounds.
cards.snark_line: A sturdy piece of the dean's authority.
cards.reward: Podium Leg, Immovable Rod. Utilize to fix it in place; holds eight thousand pounds.

ledger.text: item +1 Silver box: Podium Leg, Bolted Once, Now Stuck Forever (Immovable Rod)

plain_mechanics.text: Bonus Action: drink it, or give it to a creature within 5 ft; the drinker regains 4d4+4 HP. One use.

cards.spoken_line: Dean's Emergency Flask, Potion of Greater Healing. Bonus Action: regain four d four plus four hit points.
cards.snark_line: He was saving it. Not any more.
cards.reward: Dean's Emergency Flask, Potion of Greater Healing. Bonus Action: regain four d four plus four hit points.

cards.snark_line: Every graduate paid in. Not one got out.
